app_info.subtitle: Social media posts scheduler
app_info.description:
Upload-Post is a social media scheduler and publishing tool for ChatGPT. Upload, auto-post, schedule, and analyze your content across 14 social networks from one conversation: Instagram (Reels, posts, carousels, Stories), TikTok, YouTube (videos and Shorts), Facebook (Pages, Reels, Stories), X (Twitter), Threads, Pinterest, LinkedIn (profiles and Pages), Bluesky, Google Business Profile, Telegram, Discord, Mastodon, and WordPress.

Ask things like "Post this video to Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts", "Schedule my Instagram posts for next week", "Cross-post this photo to all my accounts", "Share this on LinkedIn and X tomorrow at 9 am", or "How did my last posts perform?".

What you can do:
- Publish videos, photos and carousels, text posts, and documents to one or many social networks at once (cross-posting), with a different caption per platform if you want.
- Upload a video straight from your computer with the built-in Upload Studio (browser-based media staging), no public link needed.
- Schedule social media posts, plan your content calendar with a posting queue, and edit or cancel scheduled posts.
- Track social media analytics: views, impressions, reach, followers, audience, and per-post performance.
- Read, reply to, and moderate comments, and manage Instagram DMs.
- Use TikTok trending music, locations, and publishing settings; get hashtag suggestions.
- Manage multiple profiles and brands, Facebook Pages, LinkedIn Pages, Pinterest boards, and Google Business reviews.
- Process media with FFmpeg before posting.

You connect your social accounts once in Upload-Post and sign in to ChatGPT with OAuth. Publishing goes through Upload-Post's official platform integrations, so ChatGPT never sees your social media passwords. A free plan includes 10 uploads per month.

Built for creators, social media managers, agencies, and marketers who want ChatGPT to handle social media management, posting, and scheduling for them.

justifications.read_only_justification: Cancels a scheduled post, changing the user's posting plan.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes the user's private Upload-Post schedule; nothing is published or removed on a social platform.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently removes the scheduled publishing job before it runs.

justifications.read_only_justification: Hides, likes, pins, edits, holds or approves a comment, or turns comments on or off for a post.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes the public state of comments on the user's connected TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube or Threads account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Every action has an inverse (unhide, unlike, unpin, enable) and nothing is permanently deleted.

justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite existing media and does not publish by itself.

justifications.read_only_justification: Posts a new comment or a reply on a published post.
justifications.open_world_justification: Publishes a public comment on the user's connected social platform.
justifications.destructive_justification: A posted comment is publicly visible immediately and cannot be recalled by this tool.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a temporary staging upload record and a signed upload URL.

test_cases.description: Publish a provided video URL to Instagram Reels with an optimized caption.
test_cases.user_prompt: Publish this video URL to Instagram Reels using profile marketing and write a concise caption for launch week.
test_cases.expected_output: Queues or starts an async Instagram video upload and returns a request ID or job status summary.

test_cases.description: Open the browser upload flow for an attached video file.
test_cases.user_prompt: Upload the attached video to Instagram, generate a caption, and use the profile automated-tests.
test_cases.expected_output: Opens the Upload Studio with profile, platform, format, and caption prefilled so the user can select the file and publish asynchronously.

test_cases.description: Schedule a text post on LinkedIn for a future time.
test_cases.user_prompt: Schedule a LinkedIn text post for next Monday at 10:00 Europe/Madrid using profile founders with copy about our product launch.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates a scheduled LinkedIn text post and returns scheduling status or a job identifier.

test_cases.description: Review analytics for a profile and a specific post.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show analytics for profile marketing over the last month and then get the metrics for request abc123.
test_cases.expected_output: Summarizes profile performance and the specific post metrics without modifying posts.

test_cases.description: Reply to an Instagram comment by DM after reading comments.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find comments on this Instagram post and privately send the guide link to the commenter with comment ID 179999.
test_cases.expected_output: Lists relevant comments and sends the requested private reply only after the user identifies the target comment.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar management.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Move my 3pm calendar meeting to tomorrow and invite the sales team.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not manage calendars or meeting invitations.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for paid advertising or campaign spend.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Boost my latest Instagram post with a $500 ad budget and target founders in Spain.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should explain that paid ad buying and budget management are outside its supported posting workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for credential recovery or secret extraction.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Find and show me the API keys or passwords for my connected Instagram account.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not retrieve or expose secrets and should direct the user to official account-management flows.
